title: Albuquerque Metropolitan Statistical Area Priority Climate Action Plan
publisher_and_lead: City of Albuquerque Sustainability Office; submitted and preserved in the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Climate Pollution Reduction Grants repository
scope: A City-led regional plan for the Albuquerque MSA: Albuquerque plus Bernalillo, Sandoval, Torrance, and Valencia counties. It establishes high-priority near-term CPRG measures across sustainable buildings, renewable energy, clean transportation, waste and recycling, and climate-conscious neighborhoods, with greenhouse-gas, frontline-community, delivery-agency, and benefits analysis.

builds_on: src-393d5c55d9ccdc0e — Central New Mexico Community-Scale Greenhouse Gas Inventory (2023)
relationship_to_existing_records.distinct_from: The 2022-2025 City implementation reports document annual progress on the 2021 City plan. This PCAP is a separate, EPA-required 2024 regional planning deliverable, rather than an implementation report or a replacement for the 2021 plan.
relationship_to_existing_records.later_work: The PCAP describes a future Comprehensive Climate Action Plan as the next CPRG planning deliverable; no successor document was identified in this review.

review_method.textual_inspection: Read title, executive summary, table of contents, program timeline, sector measures, measure table, and appendix content.
review_method.visual_inspection: Rendered and inspected cover, executive summary, measure table, measure index, and representative appendix pages. No material layout defect was found.

decision.rationale: This is a substantive, complete 308-page official regional climate-planning record with a different jurisdiction, grant-program purpose, measure set, and evidence base from the existing City plan and implementation reports. It should be presented separately, not merged into those records.
